'''Untas''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|That so-called friend of mine just left me to fed for my self while he hides out. Protect him from the bounty hunter he said. Protect yourself I say.|[[Sleash]], to a bounty hunter|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
Untas was an elite [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] mercenary<ref name="JDW" /> who usually wore a [[Bounty Hunter Armor]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Untas resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He was friend with [[Sleash]] and was acquainted with [[Oldksam]] and [[Taibela]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Untas was indebted to the crime boss [[Faeto]]. When Faeto placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on him, Untas, Oldksam and Sleash went into hiding. Untas joined the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> a front for illegal activities of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization]].<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref>

Nevertheless, Taibela stayed in Mos Eisley where she was questioned by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The bounty hunter persuaded her to reveal where Oldksam was hiding and, after finding him, convinced Oldksam to reveal Sleash's location. The bounty hunter later questioned Sleash and gave him his favorite [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The drug addict was upset that Untas went into hiding without him and therefore gave his former partner's location, the [[White Thranta Shipping offices]] outside Mos Eisley. The bounty hunter infiltrated the bunker and finally found Untas. After giving Faeto's death mark to Untas, the bounty hunter killed him.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Untas was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Untas was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
